card.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
card.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call the taxi yet. We're packed, but we haven't settled last night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised for telling my sister about your debt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay a minute. I can't face her checking what I order tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's already paid for dinner. We'll be late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll be late. Sit with me and help me believe you're coming as my partner, not to report how grateful I am.

mechanism: A delays departure despite a settled practical plan because an apology has not restored trust in the partnership.
confusable: Unlike refusing a dinner invitation, A must seek present reassurance that the relationship is repaired.
comparison: D74-b asks to sit and restore partnership before a paid dinner; D74-a asks for nine minutes after the dishes are done.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
